input_data.text: Dear Customer, Your SBI Yono NetBanking account will be permanently deactivated today due to incomplete PAN KYC. Immediately update your KYC details to restore transactions: http://sbi-yono-kyc-update.xyz/login. Do not ignore or your funds will be seized.

expected_passport.expected_action: Do not open the link or enter banking passwords/OTP. Banks never send KYC update links via SMS or Telegram.
